recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if future build tooling begins publishing source/medication/Archive content as active examples or if a separate invalid Medication reference is found in current build-scope source.
issue_request: FHIR-10285 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 technical correction for FHIR-core Medication examples from the downloads page. It reported that medicationexample4 JSON/XML used package content item reference value "MedicationExample14", which was neither a URL, relative FHIR reference, nor contained-resource reference.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-10285, but git history shows the specific XML defect was fixed before the Jira was opened: commit 036e51c6f2 changed source/medication/medicationexample4.xml from "MedicationExample14" to "Medication/medexample014". The Jira resolution/comment records that new examples were added, old examples removed, and the reported examples no longer appeared to be a problem. The legacy medicationexample4 file was later preserved under source/medication/Archive by d402f77166.
additional_context: Medication remains active in source/fhir.ini, but the active source/medication/list-Medication-examples.xml list references current examples such as Medication/medicationexample1, Medication/medexample015, and Medication/med0301 rather than medexample004. The only remaining medexample004 occurrence is source/medication/Archive/medicationexample4.xml, whose package content reference is already the valid relative reference Medication/medexample014. Zulip search found only the source-control notification for the historical fix, and Confluence searches found no contrary work-group record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build-scope Medication examples are already free of the bad reference, and the archived legacy file is corrected.
